headline: Weather Disruptions Push International Prices for Cocoa, Coffee, and Sugar Higher
summary: International prices for key agricultural exports including cocoa, coffee, and sugar remain at elevated levels due to severe weather patterns. The rally impacts earnings for Peruvian agricultural exporters and global food processors.
why: Peru is a major global exporter of specialty coffee and agricultural commodities.

impacts.name: Coffee
impacts.why: Adverse weather events pushed agricultural prices for coffee, cocoa, and sugar higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weather-driven supply constraints maintained upward momentum in global soft commodity prices.
